candidats.titre: File:Pacific Friendship 2026- US Army general visits engineering project at Quang Xuan Primary School (9782640).jpg
candidats.description: U.S. Army Command Sgt. Maj. Jennifer Francis, senior enlisted advisor for 18th Theater Medical Command, mixes mortar during construction operations at Quang Xuan Primary School as part of Pacific Partnership and Pacific Friendship 2026 in Quang Tri, Vietnam, June 29, 2026. U.S. Army Soldiers and U.S. Navy Sailors worked together to build classrooms that will support local students. Pacific Friendship 2026 is a U.S. Army Pacific-led humanitarian assistance and disaster relief engagement conducted in partnership with the Vietnamese People’s Army. (U.S. Army photo by Spc. Fabian Jones)
